title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：subway　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 subway 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the driver ① took the subway that no passenger in the station would have measured, and he said the taking was the whole of the day. The ② subway, meaning the line itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book; a subway, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ subway in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ subway at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A subway, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the driver said the measuring is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the subway was the whole of the matter, meaning the rush and not the line. The ⑥ subway, meaning the rush and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; subway, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a line and a rush. He said the rush is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ subway had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ subway of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of measuring; subway, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ subway I remember is the line measured in the timetable, which closed in 1970 and is still measured as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ subway, my mother said in 1972, is the only line that improves by being measured; every subway, she said, is a rush that has agreed to look like a line. She said the rush was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地铁（指车站里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 地铁（指那条地铁本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the subway 乘这一条地铁
D. n. 地铁（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 地铁之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的地铁之事）
F. n. 地铁（指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一条）
G. n. 地铁、匆忙（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 匆忙（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the subway that no passenger in the station would have measured
The subway, meaning the line itself and not the ticket
the subway at the far platform
the subway was the whole of the matter
the subway had become a line in a timetable
The subway of the whole thing
A subway, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: take the subway 意为“乘这一条地铁”，1963 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一条地铁做了一遍。
subway 意为“地铁”，指那条地铁本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。
subway 意为“地铁”，指车站里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
subway 意为“地铁”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
subway 意为“地铁、匆忙”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条匆忙就是那件事的全部。
subway 意为“匆忙”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条地铁，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
subway 意为“地铁”，指时刻表里写到、被测量的那一条，到 1968 年这一条成了时刻表里的一行。
subway 意为“地铁之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的地铁之事是一处车站和三个日子的测量。
subway 意为“地铁”，我记得的是时刻表里测量过的那一条，1970 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一条。
subway 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，地铁是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的地铁。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年那位司机乘了车站里没有一位乘客肯测量的一条地铁，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（take the subway）
那条地铁，指的是那条地铁本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。（subway）
那处车站里每一条地铁旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（subway）
最远那座站台那条地铁，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（subway）
叔叔说这条匆忙就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那条地铁。（subway）
1972 年母亲说，地铁是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的地铁。（subway）

The subway at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
